investigations.name: Stadtwerke Langenfeld GmbH public charging
investigations.evidence: First-party tariff valid since 2025-10-01 specifies direct AC at own stations: 0.72 EUR/kWh + 0.75 EUR/session; blocking 0.10 EUR/min after 180 min from 06:00-21:00. First-party announcement dated 2026-09-02 confirms first own DC station entered service 2026-09-01 with two 75 kW connectors. Current tariff table does not state an own-station direct DC kWh price.
investigations.exactGap: DC direct energy price for the two Rathausparkplatz connectors is not published; AC is closed but the new DC class prevents complete status.
investigations.resumeCondition: Current Rathausparkplatz DC checkout/feed price or updated first-party tariff.

investigations.name: Stadtwerke Ahrensburg GmbH
investigations.evidence: Current first-party page enumerates 11 public locations and confirms QR direct charging, but gives no numeric direct price. Current secondary station records conflict between 0.50 EUR/kWh plus fees and 0.42 EUR/kWh at one site.
investigations.exactGap: No authoritative numeric per-EVSE matrix reconciles the direct-price conflict across the 11-location estate.
investigations.resumeCondition: First-party QR checkout or authoritative per-EVSE records for all locations.

nextSafeAction: Continue a different small-estate B1/B3/B6 candidate; do not revisit these gaps without new authoritative evidence.
